paper_title: Approximate Pricing in Networks: How to Boost the Betweenness and Revenue of a Node
classifications: Theory of computation → Approximation algorithms analysis
Theory of computation → Graph algorithms analysis
statement: An interesting way to look at our problem is from a game theory perspective. Now that we know what one node will do (approximately), what will happen if the nodes correspond to strategic players? Will they settle in a stable scenario where everybody gets some revenue, or will it end in a “price war” where the revenue of each player becomes zero?
context: We settle most cases of FLOW-NPP and REV-NPP in this paper but a case which is not completely settled is REV-NPP(C2).
